Ivy: Quick check  Saturday: farmers market in the morning, pop-up boardgame meetup in the afternoon, or volunteering shift at the animal shelter? low-key, anyone in?
Noah: Farmers market for me  cant resist fresh croissants. what time are people thinking?
Priya: Im into the shelter shift if its only a couple hours. I can do 10am-12pm.
Gabe: Boardgames please  I finally have the new coop game and want guinea pig testers. afternoon works best.
Ivy: Sounds like we have split tastes. quick micro-poll: market / games / shelter.
Noah: market > games > shelter.
Priya: shelter > market > games.
Gabe: games > market > shelter.
Ivy: market > games > shelter (Im bringing a picnic blanket if market wins).
CalendarBot: Poll closed: market (2), games (2), shelter (1). Suggested plan: market in the AM, optional games meetup PM, volunteer shift as separate sign-up.
Noah: Love that compromise  Ill do market + maybe games after. anyone want to carpool? I have room for two.
Priya: Ill do shelter this time then, but would love to join next weekend for market. posting the shelter volunteer signup: https://volunteer.example/shelter-shifts
Gabe: If market folks want games after, Ill host at my place around 3pm. bring snacks and your favorite two-player game.
Ivy: Plan: meet at Greenway Market 9:30am, wander stalls until 11:30, picnic on the lawn. stash a note at Gabes if youre joining games at 3pm.
Noah: Ill bring a small cooler and coffee thermos. whos on pastry duty?
Ivy: I can grab croissants from Little Oven. also picking up a loaf of sourdough for sandwiches.
Gabe: Ill bring plates, napkins, and the new coop game  also a tiny speaker.
Priya: Shelter volunteers: bring gloves and comfy shoes. Ill bring masks and hand sanitizer.
Ivy: Tiny checklist for the thread: cash/tote, sunscreen, water bottle, comfy shoes, dog treats (for the shelter crew), picnic blanket.
Noah: Heads-up market has a plant stall that usually does $5 succulents. fyi.
Gabe: If anyone needs a ride to my place for games DM me. park on the side street, not the driveway if possible.
CalendarBot: Event created: "Greenway Market + Optional Games" Sat 2026-12-05 09:30 PST  attendees: Ivy, Noah, Gabe (Priya volunteered at shelter)  https://calendar.example/evt/555123
Ivy: Sweet. If plans change ping the thread. See you Saturday  market croissants await! :croissant:
Priya: Good luck with the croissants  Ill send dog pics from the shelter later. :paw_prints:
Noah: Cant wait. :raised_hands:
Gabe: Game faces on for later. :game_die:
